capabilities: Highlight and annotate PDFs, EPUB books, web pages and videos with colours, notes, area captures and freehand drawings
Store every annotation as a Markdown block in a per-source annotation note inside the vault
Import annotations that other programs (Preview, Acrobat, reference managers) wrote into a PDF
Export annotated PDF copies, summary notes, individual annotation notes, and Hypothesis JSON
Record reading progress per source and build a Base of everything annotated
extras: README states iOS/iPadOS support has only been tested in the Simulator, scanned PDFs get no OCR, encrypted PDFs cannot be exported, and PDF annotation is on Obsidian's public roadmap for November 2026. Styling and security details live in separate files (STYLING.md, SECURITY.md).
intentEvidence: The reader works on Obsidian's built-in PDF view. Three buttons are added to the view's header
problem: Obsidian's PDF view has no highlighting or note-taking, and annotations made in other programs stay outside the vault instead of living as ordinary Markdown blocks.

relations.evidence: Zotero can stay your library while you annotate in Obsidian.
Nothing is loaded from the Hypothesis client any more.
variables you can set from a CSS snippet or the Style Settings plugin

summary: Reader that lets you highlight and annotate PDFs, EPUB books, web pages and videos in Obsidian, storing every annotation as Markdown in your notes.
